title: ELS Parser Golden Set
description: Per-state golden set used by evaluation/eval_parser.py to grade the parser. Each file is the hand-verified expected output of parse_hierarchy for one frozen detection.json input. Distinct from golden_set.schema.json (which grades the detector): the parser produces fully resolved, NESTED NormalizedStandard objects, so each expected entry mirrors that whole object.

source_detection.description: Which detection.json this golden was verified against, e.g. 'outputs/05-31-26/CA-detection.json'.

standards.description: Hand-verified expected parser standards. You do NOT need to annotate every standard the parser emits; cover representative indicators plus the edge cases the regression_cases target. Each entry is matched to a parser-output standard by (indicator.name, age_band) and then graded field-by-field.

test_case_id.description: Stable id, e.g. CA-STD-01-EARLY. Used in failure messages.

expected.description: The expected NormalizedStandard for this indicator, graded for exact equality field-by-field. source_text is intentionally omitted — it's verbatim multi-line prose that's impractical to hand-author, so it is neither expected nor compared.

regression_cases.description: Parser-stage behavioural assertions. Checked by eval_parser.py via regression_checks.lookup_parser (check_parser_<id>); a case with no parser check is SKIPped.
